sar_narrative: Entity SYN_98ae21bc, a Switzerland-incorporated legal/accounting firm, exhibited activity consistent with sanctions risk and rapid movement of funds. Between 2026-04-22 and 2026-04-23, the entity processed three round-number outbound wires totaling 5,250,000.00 USD, including a 250,000.00 USD transfer to Stanley Black & Decker, Inc., which is identified as an OFAC hit with a match score of 1.0. Additionally, two transfers of 2,500,000.00 USD each were sent on 2026-04-23 to GGZUX Imports LLC (BVI) and UUNKE Imports LLC (Delaware-US). This activity represents a significant deviation from the declared monthly volume of 52,531.00 USD, with a vs_declared_volume_ratio of 99.94. The extreme velocity and high-value transfers to a sanctioned entity and a BVI-based entity warrant further review. This matter is referred to a human investigator.
